   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">LINCOLN EDUCATIONAL SERVICES CORPORATION AND SUBSIDIARIES</span>

   <a id="NOTES" title="NOTES"></a><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">NOTES TO CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</span>

   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">THREE MONTHS ENDED MARCH 31, 2026 AND 2025</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: center; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">(In thousands, except share and per share amounts and unless otherwise stated)</span>
  </div><div>

  </div><div>
  </div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_OrganizationConsolidationBasisOfPresentationBusinessDescriptionAndAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:OrganizationConsolidationBasisOfPresentationBusinessDescriptionAndAccountingPoliciesTextBlock" id="ixv-2926"><div style="text-indent: -27pt; padding-left: 27pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">1.</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">DESCRIPTION OF BUSINESS AND BASIS OF PRESENTATION</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="linc_BusinessActivitiesPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="linc:BusinessActivitiesPolicyTextBlock" id="ixv-2934"><div style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> <span style="font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Business Activities</span>&#8212; Lincoln Educational Services Corporation and its subsidiaries (collectively, the &#8220;Company&#8221;, &#8220;we&#8221;, &#8220;our&#8221; and &#8220;us&#8221;, as applicable) provide diversified career-oriented postsecondary education to recent high school graduates and working adults. The Company, which currently operates <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:NumberOfCampuses" scale="0" unitRef="Campus" id="ixv-7588">22</ix:nonFraction> campuses in <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:NumberOfStatesInWhichEntityOperates" scale="0" unitRef="State" id="ixv-7589">12</ix:nonFraction> states, recently entered into leases for <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="linc:NumberOfNewCampuses" scale="0" unitRef="Campus" id="ixv-7590">two</ix:nonFraction> new campuses: one in Hicksville, New York, with programs expected to begin by the end of 2026, and one in Rowlett, Texas, a northern suburb of Dallas, where the lease commenced in the fourth quarter of 2025, and programs are expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027. The Company offers programs in skilled trades,<span> automotive, health sciences and information technology</span>. The schools operate under the brands Lincoln Technical Institute, Lincoln College of Technology and Nashville Auto Diesel College. </div></ix:nonNumeric>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:continuation id="linc_BusinessActivitiesPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Most of the Company&#8217;s campuses serve major metropolitan markets and each typically offers courses in multiple areas of study. <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="linc:NumberOfCampusesTreatedAsDestinationSchools" scale="0" unitRef="Campus" id="ixv-7591">Five</ix:nonFraction> of the campuses are destination schools, which attract students from across the United States and, in some cases, from abroad. The Company&#8217;s other campuses primarily attract students from their local communities and surrounding areas. All of the campuses are nationally accredited and are eligible to participate in federal financial aid programs administered by the U.S. Department of Education (&#8220;the DOE&#8221;) and applicable state education agencies and accrediting commissions, which allow students to apply for and access federal student loans as well as other forms of financial aid. The Company was incorporated in New Jersey in 2003 as the successor-in-interest to various acquired schools including Lincoln Technical Institute, Inc., which opened its first campus in Newark, New Jersey in 1946.</span> </div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>

  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock" id="ixv-2945"><div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><b><i><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Basis of
Presentation</span></i></b><span style="font-size: 10pt;"> &#8211; The
accompanying unaudited Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements have been
prepared by the Company pursuant to the rules and regulations of the United
States Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;SEC&#8221;) and in accordance with
accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America
(&#8220;GAAP&#8221;) for interim financial statements. Certain information and footnote
disclosures normally included in annual financial statements have been omitted
or condensed pursuant to such regulations. These financial statements, which
should be read in conjunction with the December 31, 2025 audited Consolidated
Financial Statements and notes thereto and related disclosures of the Company
included in the Company&#8217;s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended
December 31, 2025 (&#8220;Form 10-K&#8221;), reflect all adjustments, consisting of normal
recurring adjustments necessary to present fairly the consolidated financial
position, results of operations and cash flows for such periods.&#160;The results
of operations for the three months ended March 31, 2026<span>,</span> are not
necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for the full fiscal
year ending December 31, 2026.</span></div></ix:nonNumeric><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <ix:continuation continuedAt="_BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_2" id="_BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Company&#8217;s business is organized into <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" scale="0" unitRef="Segment" id="ixv-7592">two</ix:nonFraction> reportable business segments: Campus Operations and Transitional. The Campus Operations segment includes campuses that are continuing in operation and contribute to the Company&#8217;s core operations and performance. All of the campuses continuing in operation are classified in this segment. The Transitional segment refers to campuses that are marked for closure and are currently being taught-out, in addition to campuses that are held-for sale. As of March 31, 2026, <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c31" decimals="INF" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="linc:NumberOfCampuses" scale="0" unitRef="Campus" id="ixv-7593">no</ix:nonFraction> campuses were classified in the Transitional segment.</span></div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><ix:continuation continuedAt="_BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_3" id="_BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_2"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We evaluate performance based on operating results. Adjustments to reconcile segment results with consolidated results are included in the caption &#8220;Corporate,&#8221; which primarily includes unallocated corporate activity.</span>
  </div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:continuation id="_BasisOfPresentationAndSignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_3"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The unaudited Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements include the accounts of the Company and its wholly owned subsidiaries. All intercompany accounts and transactions have been eliminated.</span>
  </div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:UseOfEstimates" id="ixv-2967"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Use of Estimates in the Preparation of Financial Statements</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> &#8211; The preparation of financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities and disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities at the date of the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements and the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the period. On an ongoing basis, the Company evaluates the estimates and assumptions, including those used to determine the incremental borrowing rate to calculate lease liabilities and right-of-use (&#8220;ROU&#8221;) assets, lease term to calculate lease cost, bad debts, impairments, useful lives of fixed assets, income taxes, benefit plans, stock-based compensation, and certain accruals. Actual results could differ from those estimates.</span> </div></ix:nonNumeric>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:StartUpActivitiesCostPolicy" id="ixv-2973"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Start-up Costs</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">&#8212;</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Costs related to the start of new campuses are expensed as incurred.</span> </div></ix:nonNumeric></ix:nonNumeric><div>

   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#160;</span>

  &#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">9</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header">&#160;</div></div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
<div class="header override"><div style="font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic;"><a href="#Index">Index</a></div></div></div><ix:continuation id="_OrganizationConsolidationBasisOfPresentationBusinessDescriptionAndAccountingPoliciesTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock" id="ixv-2993"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">New Accounting Pronouncements</span></div></ix:nonNumeric>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><ix:continuation continuedAt="_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2" id="_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">In November 2024, the Financial Accounting Standard Board (FASB) issued Accounting Standards Update (&#8220;ASU&#8221;) 2024-03, </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Income Statement &#8211; Reporting Comprehensive Income &#8211; Expense Disaggregation Disclosures (Topic 220</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">): </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Disaggregation of Income Statement Expenses</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">, which requires additional disclosure of certain amounts included in the expense captions presented on the statements of operations, as well as disclosures about selling expenses. The ASU is effective on a prospective basis, with the option for retrospective application for periods beginning after December 15, 2026, and interim reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2027. Early adoption is permitted for annual financial statements that have not yet been issued. The Company does not expect the adoption of this ASU to have a material impact on its Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements.</span></div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><ix:continuation continuedAt="_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_3" id="_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">In September 2025, the FASB issued ASU 2025-06, </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Intangibles Goodwill and Other- Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40): Targeted Improvements to the Accounting for Internal-Use Software. </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The ASU amends the internal-use software cost capitalization model by eliminating stage-based rules and introduces new capitalization criteria based on management authorization and the probability of project completion. This ASU also clarifies the treatment of software development uncertainty and incorporates guidance on website development costs. The amendments are effective for fiscal years beginning after December 15, 2027, and interim periods within those fiscal years. ASU 2025-06 may be applied prospectively, retrospectively or on a modified transition approach with early adoption permitted. We do not expect this ASU to have a material impact on our Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements.</span></div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><ix:continuation id="_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_3"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   In December 2025, the FASB issued ASU 2025-11, <span style="font-style: italic;">Interim Reporting (Topic 270): Narrow-Scope Improvements</span>, which clarifies the guidance in Topic 270 to improve the consistency and navigability of interim financial reporting. The ASU provides a comprehensive list of required interim disclosures and introduces a disclosure principle requiring entities to disclose events occurring since the end of the last annual reporting period that have a material impact on the entity. ASU 2025-11 is effective for fiscal years beginning after December 15, 2027, including interim periods within those fiscal years. Early adoption is permitted. The Company is currently evaluating the impact of adopting ASU 2025-11 on its interim Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements and disclosures.</div></ix:continuation>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock" id="ixv-3015"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Income Taxes</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#8212; The Company accounts for income taxes in accordance with Accounting Standards Codification (&#8220;ASC&#8221;) Topic 740, </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Income Taxes</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> (&#8220;ASC 740&#8221;). This statement requires an asset and a liability approach for measuring deferred taxes based on temporary differences between the financial statement and tax bases of assets and liabilities existing at each balance sheet date using enacted tax rates for years in which taxes are expected to be paid or recovered.</span> </div></ix:nonNumeric>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:continuation continuedAt="_IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2" id="_IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">In accordance with ASC 740, the Company assesses its deferred tax asset to determine whether all or any portion of the asset is more likely than not unrealizable. A valuation allowance is required to be established or maintained when, based on currently available information, it is more likely than not that all or a portion of a deferred tax asset will not be realized. In accordance with ASC 740, our assessment considers whether there has been sufficient income in recent years and whether sufficient income is expected in future years in order to utilize the deferred tax asset. In evaluating the realizability of deferred income tax assets, the Company considers, among other things, historical levels of income, expected future income, the expected timing of the reversals of existing temporary reporting differences, and the expected impact of tax planning strategies that may be implemented to prevent the potential loss of future income tax benefits. Significant judgment is required in determining the future tax consequences of events that have been recognized in our Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements and/or tax returns. Differences between anticipated and actual outcomes of these future tax consequences could have a material impact on the Company&#8217;s consolidated financial position or results of operations. Changes in, among other things, income tax legislation, statutory income tax rates or future income levels could materially impact the Company&#8217;s valuation of income tax assets and liabilities and could cause our income tax provision to vary significantly among financial reporting periods.</span>
  </div></ix:continuation>

  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <ix:continuation continuedAt="_IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_3" id="_IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_2"><div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">We recognize
accrued interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits in income
tax expense. During the three months ended March 31, 2026<span>,</span> and
2025, we did <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="-3" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpense" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7594"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-3" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefitsIncomeTaxPenaltiesAndInterestExpense" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7595"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c30" decimals="-3" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefits" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7596"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="-3" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:UnrecognizedTaxBenefits" scale="3" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7597">no</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction>t record any interest and penalties expense associated with
uncertain tax positions, as we did not have any uncertain tax positions.</span></div></ix:continuation><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <ix:continuation id="_IncomeTaxPolicyTextBlock-c0_cont_3"><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">On July 4, 2025, the U.S. enacted legislation which generally extends the tax provisions enacted in 2017 that were set to expire at the end of 2025 and makes other changes to federal tax law for multinational corporations. The Company is currently evaluating the impact of the new legislation but does not expect it to have a material impact on the financial results of operations for the current year.</span>
  </div></ix:continuation></ix:continuation><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div><div>

  &#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">10</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header">&#160;</div></div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
<div class="header override"><div style="font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic;"><a href="#Index">Index</a></div></div></div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerShareTextBlock" id="ixv-3049"><div style="text-indent: -27pt; padding-left: 27pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">2.</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">NET EARNINGS PER COMMON SHARE</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Basic and diluted earnings per share (&#8220;EPS&#8221;) are calculated in accordance with ASC 260, Earnings Per Share (&#8220;ASC 260&#8221;), which specifies the computation, presentation and disclosure requirements for EPS. Under ASC 260, basic EPS excludes all dilutive Common Stock equivalents. It is computed by dividing net income by the weighted average number of common shares outstanding during the period. Diluted EPS, as calculated using the treasury stock method, reflects the potential dilution from employee incentive plans during the period.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>

  </div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerTextBlock" id="ixv-3131"><div style="text-indent: -27pt; padding-left: 27pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">3.</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">REVENUE RECOGNITION</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Substantially all of our revenues are considered to be revenues from contracts with students. We determine standalone selling price based on the price at which the distinct services or goods are sold separately. The related accounts receivable balances are recorded in our balance sheets as student accounts receivable. We do not have significant revenue recognized from performance obligations that were satisfied in prior periods, and we do not have any transaction price allocated to unsatisfied performance obligations other than in our unearned tuition. We record revenue for students who withdraw from our schools only to the extent that it is probable that a significant reversal in the amount of cumulative revenue recognized will not occur. In addition, to reduce the amount of outstanding accounts receivable balances due from our students, the Company employs a continuous collection effort. Unearned tuition represents contract liabilities primarily related to our tuition revenue. We have elected not to provide disclosure about transaction prices allocated to unsatisfied performance obligations if the original contract durations are less than one-year, or if we have the right to consideration from a student in an amount that corresponds directly with the value provided to the student for performance obligations completed to date in accordance with ASC Topic 606, </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Revenue from Contracts with Customers</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">. We have assessed the costs incurred to obtain a contract with a student and determined them to be immaterial.</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Unearned tuition
in the amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7604">39.3</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c3" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityCurrent" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7605">44.2</ix:nonFraction> million is recorded in the current
liabilities section of the accompanying Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets
as of March 31, 2026<span>,</span> and December 31, 2025, respectively.
The change in this contract liability balance during the three months ended
March 31, 2026, is the result of payments received in advance of satisfying
performance obligations, offset by revenue
recognized during that period. Revenue recognized for the three months ended
March 31, 2026, that was included in the contract liability balance at the
beginning of the year was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerLiabilityRevenueRecognized" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7606">38.8</ix:nonFraction> million.</span></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>

  </div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" continuedAt="_LesseeOperatingLeasesTextBlock-c0_cont_1" escape="true" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeasesTextBlock" id="ixv-3331"><div style="text-indent: -27pt; padding-left: 27pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">4.</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">LEASES</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Company enters into contracts to utilize office space, educational facilities, and various items of equipment under lease agreements and accounts for them in accordance with ASC 842, </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Leases </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">(&#8220;ASC 842&#8221;). To determine whether a contract contains a lease, the Company assesses whether there is an identified asset and whether the Company has the right to control its use throughout the period of use. The Company classifies leases as either operating or finance leases at lease commencement date in accordance with ASC 842. As required under ASC 842, the Company recognizes a ROU asset and a corresponding lease liability on the balance sheet, measured at the present value of lease payments over the term of the lease. An operating lease ROU asset represents the Company&#8217;s right to use the underlying asset during the lease term and the corresponding lease liability represents its obligation to make lease payments. Operating lease ROU assets and liabilities are amortized over the lease term, with lease expense recognized on a straight-line basis within operating expenses in the Condensed Consolidated Statement of Operations. Finance lease arrangements result in separate recognition of interest expense on the lease liability using the effective interest method and amortization expense of the ROU asset on a straight-line basis over the lease term, in addition to principal payments.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">As the Company&#8217;s operating leases do not provide an implicit rate, the Company uses an incremental borrowing rate based on the information available on the commencement date in determining the present value of lease payments. We estimate the incremental borrowing rate based on a yield curve analysis, utilizing the interest rate derived from the fair value analysis of our credit facility and adjusting it for factors that appropriately reflect the profile of secured borrowing over the expected term of the lease. The operating lease ROU assets include any lease payments made prior to the rent commencement date and exclude lease incentives. Our leases have remaining lease terms of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c42" format="ixt-sec:duryear" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseRemainingLeaseTerm" id="ixv-7619">1</ix:nonNumeric> year to <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c43" format="ixt-sec:duryear" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseRemainingLeaseTerm" id="ixv-7620">20</ix:nonNumeric> years. Lease terms may include options to extend the lease term used in determining the lease obligation when it is reasonably certain that the Company will exercise that option. Lease expense for lease payments is recognized on a straight-line basis over the lease term for operating leases.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:LeaseCostTableTextBlock" id="ixv-3349"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The following table presents components of lease cost and classification on the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations:</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>

  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The
net change in ROU asset and operating lease liability is included in the net
change in other assets in the Condensed Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows
for the three months ended March 31, 2026<span>,</span> and
2025.</span></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The net change in ROU asset and finance lease liability is split between principal payments, interest expense and amortization expense. Principal payments are classified in the financing section, interest expense is included in net income and amortization expense is broken out separately in the operating section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows.</span>

     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">5.</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">GOODWILL AND LONG-LIVED ASSETS</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Company reviews the carrying value of its long-lived assets and identifiable intangibles annually, or more frequently if necessary, for possible impairment whenever events or changes in circumstances indicate that the carrying amounts may not be recoverable. If the Company determines that an asset&#8217;s carrying value is impaired, it will record a write-down of the carrying value of the asset and charge the impairment as an operating expense in the period in which the determination is made. For other long-lived assets, including ROU lease assets, the Company evaluates assets for recoverability when there is an indication of potential impairment. If the undiscounted cash flows from a group of assets being evaluated are less than the carrying value of that group of assets, the fair value of the asset group is determined and the carrying value of the asset group is written down to fair value.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">When we perform the quantitative impairment test for long-lived assets, we examine estimated future cash flows using Level 3 inputs. These cash flows are evaluated by using weighted probability techniques as well as comparisons of past performance against projections. Assets may also be evaluated by identifying independent market values.</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">During the three months ended March 31, 2026<span>,</span> and
2025, there were <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="-6" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7666"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="-6" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7667"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-6" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7668"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-6" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7669">no</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> impairments of goodwill or long-lived assets.</span></div></ix:nonNumeric><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">

property, equipment and facilities was driven by several factors, including an

and expanded programs at various campuses; and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c52" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditions" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7701">5.4</ix:nonFraction> million of facilities
upgrades including security and campus upgrades/refurbishments, with the
remainder relating to training materials and equipment. Depreciation and
amortization expense of property, equipment and facilities was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:Depreciation" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7702">7.6</ix:nonFraction> million and
$<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:Depreciation" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7703">3.8</ix:nonFraction> million for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively,
which includes amortization of finance leases of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortization" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7704">0.4</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortization" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7705">0.4</ix:nonFraction> million

  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Credit Facility</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>

  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">On February 16,
2024, the Company entered into a secured credit agreement (the &#8220;Credit
Agreement&#8221;) with Fifth Third Bank, National Association<span style="text-decoration: underline;">,</span>
pursuant to which the Company, as borrower, obtained a revolving credit
facility in the aggregate principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c67" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7706">40.0</ix:nonFraction> million, including a $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c68" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7707">10.0</ix:nonFraction>
million letter of credit sublimit and a $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c69" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7708">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million accordion feature (the
&#8220;Facility&#8221;), the proceeds of which are to be used for working capital, general
corporate and certain other permitted purposes. The initial term of the
Facility was <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c70" format="ixt-sec:durmonth" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentTerm" id="ixv-7709">36</ix:nonNumeric> months, maturing on February 16, 2027. </span></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">On July 18, 2024, the Company entered into a first amendment (the &#8220;First Amendment&#8221;) to the Credit Agreement. Among other things, the First Amendment effected certain modifications to (i) clarify certain representations and affirmative covenants of the Company, (ii) clarify certain conditions to each advance, (iii) clarify and/or replace certain events of default and (iv) delete or revise certain definitions in order to harmonize them with the other modifications made. The First Amendment also contained customary releases, representations, warranties, and reaffirmations consistent with the original terms of the Credit Agreement. Except as set forth above, the First Amendment did not materially alter the Credit Agreement.</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">On March 11, 2025, the Company entered into a second amendment (the &#8220;Second Amendment&#8221;) to the Credit Agreement, which increased the aggregate principal amount available under the Facility from $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c67" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7710">40.0</ix:nonFraction> million to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c71" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7711">60.0</ix:nonFraction> million. The Second Amendment also expanded the accordion feature from $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c69" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7712">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c72" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7713">25.0</ix:nonFraction> million and extended the maturity date of the Facility from February 16, 2027 to March 7, 2028. Except as set forth above, the Second Amendment did not materially alter the Credit Agreement.</span></div></ix:nonNumeric><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">

  &#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">

<div class="header">&#160;</div></div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
<div class="header override"><div style="font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic;"><a href="#Index">Index</a></div></div></div><div>
  </div><ix:continuation id="_LongTermDebtTextBlock-c0_cont_1"><div> On April 13, 2026, the
Company entered into an amended and restated credit agreement (the &#8220;Amended and
Restated Credit Agreement&#8221;) with the lenders referred to therein (the
&#8220;Lenders&#8221;), including Fifth Third Bank, National Association as lender and as
administrative agent, joint lead arranger, and joint bookrunner (the &#8220;Bank&#8221;),
and Flagstar Bank, N.A., Provident Bank and Santander Bank, N.A. as lenders and
as joint lead arrangers and joint bookrunners.&#160;The Amended
and Restated Credit Agreement, which replaces the Credit Agreement, provides
the Company, as borrower, with a revolving credit facility in the aggregate
principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c73" decimals="-6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7714">125</ix:nonFraction> million, with a $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c74" decimals="-6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7715">10</ix:nonFraction> million letter of credit sublimit
and a $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c75" decimals="-6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7716">25</ix:nonFraction> million accordion feature, and extends the maturity date from March 7, 2028<span style="text-decoration:underline; text-underline:single; color:green; ">,</span> to
April 11, 2031<span style="text-decoration:underline; text-underline:single; color:green; "> </span>(the &#8220;Amended and Restated
Facility&#8221;). The proceeds of the Amended and Restated Facility may be used for
working capital, general corporate and certain other permitted purposes.</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The Amended and
Restated Facility is guaranteed by the Company&#8217;s wholly-owned subsidiaries and
is secured by a first-priority lien in favor of <span>Fifth
Third</span> Bank<span>, National Association</span>, for the
benefit of the Lenders, on substantially all of the personal property owned by
the Company and its subsidiaries pursuant to an amended and restated guaranty
and security agreement, dated as of April 13, 2026.&#160; </span></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Each advance
under the Amended and Restated Facility will bear interest on the outstanding
principal amount thereof from the date when made at an interest rate
determined, at the election of the Company, at either the tranche rate (which
is the forward-looking Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) for <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c76" continuedAt="linc_DebtInstrumentTermOfVariableRate-c76_cont_1" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" name="linc:DebtInstrumentTermOfVariableRate" id="ixv-7717">one</ix:nonNumeric> or <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c77" format="ixt-sec:durwordsen" name="linc:DebtInstrumentTermOfVariableRate" id="ixv-7718">three<ix:continuation id="linc_DebtInstrumentTermOfVariableRate-c76_cont_1">
months</ix:continuation></ix:nonNumeric>), or the base rate (which is a variable per annum rate, as of any date
of determination, equal to the prime rate), plus an applicable margin. The
applicable margin is determined pursuant to a pricing grid, which for loans
subject to the tranche rate varies from <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c78" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7720">1.50</ix:nonFraction>% to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c79" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7721">2.25</ix:nonFraction>%, and, for loans subject
to the base rate varies from <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c80" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7722">0.50</ix:nonFraction>% to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c81" decimals="4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7723">1.25</ix:nonFraction>%. The applicable margin may change
quarterly based on the total leverage ratio at such time.&#160;The total
leverage ratio is determined with respect to the Company and its subsidiaries
on a consolidated basis for an applicable quarterly period by dividing the
aggregate principal amount of various forms of borrowed indebtedness as of the
last day of a determination period by EBITDA (earnings before interest expense,
taxes, depreciation and amortization) for such period.&#160; Interest is
payable in arrears, either <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c70" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFrequencyOfPeriodicPayment" id="ixv-7724">quarterly or monthly</ix:nonNumeric>, depending on the Company&#8217;s
interest rate election, with the principal due at maturity.</span></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Amended and Restated Credit Agreement contains various customary representations, warranties and affirmative, negative and financial covenants, as well as events of default customary for facilities of this type.</span></div>

  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><span>In
connection with the</span> Credit Agreement, the Company has incurred a
total of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c70" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:PaymentsForClosingFee" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7725">0.6</ix:nonFraction> million in bank and legal fees consisting of
approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c70" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LegalFees" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7726">0.5</ix:nonFraction> million to execute the <span>Facility</span>
and an additional $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c70" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnusedBorrowingCapacityFee" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7727">0.1</ix:nonFraction> million relating to the Second Amendment.&#160;
Currently, these fees have been capitalized and are being amortized over the
term of the Second Amendment to the Credit Agreement.&#160;Similarly, any
additional bank and legal fees incurred in connection with the execution of the
Amended and Restated Credit Agreement as well as previously capitalized costs
will be capitalized and amortized over the term of the Amended
and Restated Credit Agreement.</span></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>

  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size:10.0pt">For the three months ended
March 31, 2026, interest paid in connection with the Credit Agreement was

March 31, 2025.</span></div><div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size:10.0pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12.0pt">&#160;</span></div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">As of March 31, 2026,&#160;the Company had $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c82" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:LineOfCredit" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7729">5.0</ix:nonFraction> million
outstanding under the Facility, which has now been repaid in connection with

   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Long-Term Incentive Plan</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Company currently maintains <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="linc:NumberOfStockIncentivePlans" scale="0" unitRef="Plan" id="ixv-7735">one</ix:nonFraction> active stock incentive plan, the Lincoln Educational Services Corporation 2020 Long-Term Incentive Plan (the &#8220;LTIP&#8221;).</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">On March 26, 2020, the Board of Directors adopted the LTIP to provide an incentive to certain directors, officers and employees of the Company to align their interests in the Company&#8217;s success with those of its shareholders through the grant of equity-based awards. On June 16, 2020, the shareholders of the Company approved the LTIP. The LTIP is administered by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors, or such other qualified committee appointed by the Board of Directors, which, among other duties, has the full power and authority to take all actions and make all determinations required or provided for under the LTIP. Pursuant to the LTIP, the Company may grant options, share appreciation rights, restricted shares, restricted share units, incentive stock options, and nonqualified stock options. Under the LTIP, employees may surrender shares to satisfy applicable income tax withholding on the vested Restricted Stock. The LTIP has a duration of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c85" format="ixt-sec:duryear" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardExpirationPeriod" id="ixv-7736">10</ix:nonNumeric> years. On February 23, 2023, the Board of Directors approved, subject to shareholder approval, an amendment of the LTIP to increase the aggregate number of shares available under the LTIP from <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c86" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7737">2,000,000</ix:nonFraction> shares to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c87" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardNumberOfSharesAvailableForGrant" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7738">4,000,000</ix:nonFraction> shares. The amendment was approved and adopted by the shareholders at the Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on May 5, 2023.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Time-Based and Performance-Based Restricted Stock Awards</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We provide stock-based compensation to employees, officers and directors in the form of awards of restricted stock (the &#8220;Restricted Stock Awards&#8221;) under our LTIP, which are conditioned upon either continued service (the &#8220;Time-Based Restricted Stock Awards&#8221;) or both continued service and achievement of performance goals (the &#8220;Performance-Based Restricted Stock Awards&#8221; or &#8220;Performance-Based Restricted Stock Shares&#8221;). Performance-Based Restricted Stock Shares granted prior to 2025, are eligible to vest only upon achievement of at least <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c88" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7739">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the performance target, with <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c88" decimals="INF" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7740">no</ix:nonFraction> shares vesting unless the target is met. In 2025, the Company granted Performance-Based Restricted Stock Shares to employees, officers, and directors that vest based on the percentage of Adjusted EBITDA achieved for the year. Under such grants, <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c89" decimals="INF" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7741">no</ix:nonFraction> shares vest in the event that less than <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c89" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7742">80</ix:nonFraction>% of the target is achieved; vesting begins at <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c90" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingRightsPercentage" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7743">25</ix:nonFraction>% for <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c89" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7744">80</ix:nonFraction>% achievement and increases on a linear scale up to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c91" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7745">200</ix:nonFraction>% vesting for achievement of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c92" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7746">120</ix:nonFraction>% or more of the target. In 2025, the Company also granted Performance-Based Restricted Stock Shares to certain executives that vest based on the achievement of a specified percentage of target Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal year 2027. Under such grants, <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c93" decimals="INF" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsGrantsInPeriod" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7747">no</ix:nonFraction> shares vest in the event that less than <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c94" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7748">90</ix:nonFraction>% of the target is achieved; vesting begins at <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c95" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingRightsPercentage" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7749">25</ix:nonFraction>% for <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c94" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7750">90</ix:nonFraction>% achievement and increases on a linear scale up to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c94" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingRightsPercentage" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7751">100</ix:nonFraction>% vesting for achievement of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c96" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardAwardVestingPerformancePercentageTarget" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7752">100</ix:nonFraction>% or more of the target.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Compensation Committee believes that a combination of Time-Based Restricted Stock Awards and Performance-Based Restricted Stock Awards, of which performance-based awards comprise <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementPerformanceBasedAwardsPercentage" scale="-2" unitRef="pure" id="ixv-7753">50</ix:nonFraction>% of the total, is well-designed to align the interests of directors, officers and employees with those of shareholders by tying compensation to the achievement of the Company&#8217;s long-term performance goals.</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Company accounts for Restricted Stock Awards in accordance with ASC 718 - </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-style: italic;">Compensation-Stock Compensation</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">, recognizing compensation expense based on the grant-date fair value of our Common Stock. Expense is recognized on a straight-line basis over the requisite service period, which is generally the vesting period, and for performance-based awards, only to the extent that it is probable the performance conditions will be achieved.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The expense related to Restricted Stock Awards for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025 was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c97" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7754">1.5</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c98" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7755">1.2</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively. The unrecognized Restricted stock expense as of March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, was $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c99" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7756">11.7</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c100" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationNonvestedAwardsTotalCompensationCostNotYetRecognizedShareBasedAwardsOtherThanOptions" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7757">6.0</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively. As of March 31, 2026, the outstanding Restricted Stock Awards under the LTIP had an aggregate intrinsic value of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c101" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsAggregateIntrinsicValueOutstanding" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7758">25.2</ix:nonFraction> million compared to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c102" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardEquityInstrumentsOtherThanOptionsAggregateIntrinsicValueOutstanding" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7759">12.9</ix:nonFraction> million in the prior year comparable period.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">For the three months ended March 31, 2026, the Company completed a net share settlement of <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c103" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardForfeited" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7760">184,834</ix:nonFraction> shares, compared to <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c104" decimals="INF" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedStockAwardForfeited" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7761">197,973</ix:nonFraction> restricted shares for the three months ended March 31, 2025. The net share settlement was performed on behalf of certain employees that participate in the LTIP upon the vesting of the restricted shares pursuant to the terms of the LTIP. The net share settlement was in connection with income taxes incurred on restricted shares that vested and were transferred to the employees during 2026,&#160;creating taxable income for the employees. At the employees&#8217; request, the Company paid these taxes on behalf of the employees in exchange for the employees returning an equivalent value of restricted shares to the Company. These transactions resulted in a decrease of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c103" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:DecreaseInEquityDueToPaymentOfTaxForEmployee" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7762">6.7</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c104" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:DecreaseInEquityDueToPaymentOfTaxForEmployee" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7763">3.6</ix:nonFraction> million for the three months ended March 31, 2026, and 2025, respectively, to equity on the Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheets as the cash payment of the taxes effectively was a repurchase of the restricted shares granted in previous years.</span> </div></ix:continuation><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>

  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Share Repurchase Program</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">On May 24, 2022, the Company announced that its Board of Directors had authorized a share repurchase program of up to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c105" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="srt:StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7774">30.0</ix:nonFraction> million of the Company&#8217;s outstanding Common Stock. The repurchase program was authorized for <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" format="ixt-sec:durmonth" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchaseProgramPeriodInForce1" id="ixv-7775">12</ix:nonNumeric> months. Pursuant to the program, purchases may be made, from time to time, in open-market transactions at prevailing market prices, in privately negotiated transactions or by other means as determined by the Company&#8217;s management and in accordance with applicable federal securities laws. The timing of purchases and the number of shares repurchased under the program will depend on a variety of factors including price, trading volume, corporate and regulatory requirements and market conditions. The Company retains the right to limit, terminate or extend the share repurchase program at any time without prior notice.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Board of Directors subsequently authorized the repurchase of an additional $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c106" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:AdditionalStockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7776">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million of the Company&#8217;s Common Stock, for an aggregate of up to $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c107" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="linc:AdditionalStockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7777">30.6</ix:nonFraction> million in additional repurchases, and extended the share repurchase program for additional <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c107" format="ixt-sec:durmonth" name="linc:AdditionalStockRepurchaseProgramPeriodInForce" id="ixv-7778">12</ix:nonNumeric>-month periods, most recently through May 24, 2027.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">During the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, the Company did <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="INF" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7779"><ix:nonFraction contextRef="c4" decimals="INF" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares" scale="0" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7780">not</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction> repurchase any shares under the share repurchase program. As of March 31, 2026, the Company had approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorizedRepurchaseAmount1" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7781">29.7</ix:nonFraction> million remaining for additional repurchases under the program. Since inception of the program, the Company has made repurchases of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c108" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares" scale="6" unitRef="shares" id="ixv-7782">1.7</ix:nonFraction> million shares of the Company&#8217;s Common Stock at an average share price of $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" scale="0" unitRef="usdPershares" id="ixv-7783">5.95</ix:nonFraction> for an aggregate expenditure of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c108" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7784">10.3</ix:nonFraction> million.</span> </div></ix:continuation><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingenciesDisclosureTextBlock" id="ixv-4362"><div style="text-indent: -27pt; padding-left: 27pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">9.</span>

     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">COMMITMENTS AND CONTINGENCIES</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Legal Proceedings</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">There are no
material developments relating to previously disclosed legal proceedings. See
the &#8220;Legal Proceedings&#8221; section of the Company&#8217;s Form 10-K and previous Form
10-Qs for information regarding existing legal proceedings. Additionally, see the
&#8220;Regulatory Updates&#8221; section of this Form 10-Q for additional information
concerning the status of Borrower Defense to Repayment applications. </span></div><div style="margin: 0in; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size:10.0pt;mso-bidi-font-size:12.0pt">&#160;</span></div>

  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">In the ordinary conduct of our business, we are subject to additional periodic lawsuits, investigations, regulatory proceedings and other claims, including, but not limited to, claims involving students or graduates, routine employment matters and business disputes. We cannot predict the ultimate resolution of these lawsuits, investigations, regulatory proceedings and other claims asserted against us, but we do not believe that any of these matters will have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, or cash flows.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Student Financing Plans</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">As of March 31, 2026, the Company had outstanding net financing commitments to its students to assist them in financing their education of approximately $<ix:nonFraction contextRef="c2" decimals="-5" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitment" scale="6" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7785">59.2</ix:nonFraction> million, net of interest.</span> </div></ix:nonNumeric><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">

  &#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">17</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header">&#160;</div></div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 10px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
<div class="header override"><div style="font-size: 8pt; font-style: italic;"><a href="#Index">Index</a></div></div></div><div>
  </div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock" id="ixv-4403"><div style="text-indent: -27pt; padding-left: 27pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27pt; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">10.</span>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
     <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold;">SEGMENT REPORTING</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="clear: both; font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Company manages its business, evaluates performance and allocates resources based on <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" scale="0" unitRef="Segment" id="ixv-7786">two</ix:nonFraction> reportable business segments, Campus Operations and Transitional.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Campus Operations &#8211; </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The Campus Operations segment includes campuses that are continuing in operation and contribute to the Company&#8217;s core operations and performance. All of our campuses continuing in operation are classified in this segment. All of our campuses offer programs across various areas of study.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0); font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Transitional &#8211;</span><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);"> The <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c109" decimals="0" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss" scale="0" unitRef="usd" id="ixv-7787">Transitional</ix:nonFraction> segment refers to campuses that are marked for closure and are currently being taught out, in addition to campuses that are held-for-sale. As of March 31, 2026, <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="0" format="ixt:fixed-zero" name="linc:NumberOfCampusClassifiedInTransitionalSegment" scale="0" unitRef="Campus" id="ixv-7788">none</ix:nonFraction> of our campuses were classified in the Transitional segment.</span> </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The individual operating segments have been aggregated into the <ix:nonFraction contextRef="c0" decimals="INF" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" scale="0" unitRef="Segment" id="ixv-7789">two</ix:nonFraction> main reportable segments based on the method by which our Chief Operating Decision Maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) 1) evaluates performance and allocates resources and 2) as a result of the Company&#8217;s judgment, that the reporting units have similar products, production processes, types of customers, methods of distribution, regulatory environment, and economic characteristics. The Company&#8217;s CODM is comprised of a team of executives deemed the &#8220;Executive Committee,&#8221; which is made up of the following individuals:</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">1. Scott M. Shaw &#8211; Chief Executive Officer and Director</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">2. Brian Meyers &#8211; Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Treasurer</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">The CODM assesses segment financial performance by reviewing segment revenue and segment operating income, which includes certain Corporate overhead allocations relating directly to the segments disclosed. Some of the allocated costs include the centralization of the Company&#8217;s financial aid process, national sales and receivables, and default costs. The CODM will make decisions to allocate resources based on the review of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial information categorized by segment. The financial information is presented to the CODM using actual-to-actual results and budget-to-actual results.</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">&#160;</span>
  </div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">
   <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">We evaluate performance based on operating results. Adjustments to reconcile segment results with consolidated results are included in the caption &#8220;Corporate,&#8221; which primarily includes unallocated corporate activity.</span></div>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" escape="true" name="us-gaap:ScheduleOfSegmentReportingInformationBySegmentTextBlock" id="ixv-4440"><div style="font-size: 10pt;"> <span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Summary financial information by reporting segment is as follows:</span></div>
